title: Fine-Tuning Without Gradients? Closed-Form, LLM-Written Classifiers on a Frozen Encoder
abstract: arXiv:2611.33972v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can a classifier computed in closed form on a frozen encoder match gradient fine-tuning? We present closed-form weight-space programming (WSP): a large language model (LLM), used as a design assistant, writes programs that read a frozen masked language model through cloze-style prompt templates at several layers, fit closed-form heads (shrinkage discriminant analysis, kernel ridge regression and the encoder's label-word prior) on labelled data, and select among a pool of candidate heads by cross-fitting. No gradient is computed and no encoder weight changes. We instantiate the framework on RoBERTa-large. On 11 development datasets with 512 to 8,192 training labels, WSP is ahead of full fine-tuning (FT) and LoRA at every label budget (by 0.3 to 0.6 points on average; the registered non-inferiority tests pass) and within 0.5 points of prompt-based fine-tuning (PFT); these datasets also shaped the recipe. With fewer labels its lead over F

translated_title: 无需梯度的微调？在冻结编码器上由大语言模型编写的闭式解分类器
translated_abstract: 在冻结编码器上以闭式解计算的分类器能否匹敌梯度微调？我们提出了闭式权重空间编程（WSP）：一个大语言模型（LLM）作为设计助手，编写程序通过多层完形填空式的提示模板读取一个冻结的掩码语言模型，在标注数据上拟合闭式分类头（收缩判别分析、核岭回归以及编码器的标签词先验），并通过交叉拟合从候选分类头池中进行选择。整个过程不计算任何梯度，也不改变编码器的权重。我们在 RoBERTa-large 上实例化了该框架。在 11 个包含 512 至 8,192 个训练标签的开发数据集上，WSP 在每个标签预算下均优于全量微调（FT）和 LoRA（平均高出 0.3 至 0.6 个百分点；预设的非劣性检验通过），且与基于提示的微调（PFT）的差距在 0.5 个百分点以内；这些数据集也参与了方案的构建。在标签更少的情况下，其相对于梯度微调方法的优势进一步扩大。
tldr: 该论文提出闭式权重空间编程（WSP）框架，让大语言模型编写程序在冻结编码器上以闭式解拟合分类头，全程无需梯度更新和权重修改，却在多个标签预算下达到甚至超过全量微调、LoRA 等梯度方法的性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes closed-form weight-space programming (WSP), where an LLM writes programs that fit closed-form classifier heads on a frozen encoder with no gradient computation, matching or outperforming full fine-tuning, LoRA, and prompt-based fine-tuning across various label budgets.
